title: InvariantFS codecpack manifest
description: WP60 registry manifest. The canonical on-disk form is the key = value text file codecpacks/<name>/<version>/manifest; this JSON schema defines the same fields for validators and tooling. Unknown keys are ignored by the v1 engine, so extends are forward-compatible.

name.description: Pack name; also the codecpacks/<name>/ directory and the installed <root>/<name>/ directory.

version.description: Semantic version of this pack release. Must equal the <version> directory component.

pack_version.description: Manifest/pack ABI version understood by the engine. Current: 1.

min_read.description: Minimum InvariantFS version whose read path can consume blobs produced by this pack.

algo.description: Numeric INVFS_ALGO_* codec id stamped into CONTAINER/CODEC records.

codec_id.description: Symbolic form of algo, e.g. INVFS_ALGO_EXT4FS.

format_id.description: Input format this pack claims, e.g. ext4, jpeg, 7z, raw_audio.

category.description: Coarse policy weight; `primary` packs are preferred unless superseded via `use`.

priority.description: Alternatives preference; higher wins when several packs provide one family and none is pinned via `invfs-pack use`.

type.description: ABI shape: codec packs carry encode/decode, container packs carry enumerate/extract/strip/rebuild.

caps.description: Capability bits, | or , separated on disk.

provides.description: Capabilities/families this pack provides, e.g. ['raw_audio'] or ['container:ext4','container'].

replaces.description: Pack ids this pack supersedes, e.g. ['builtin:jxl']. Informational for alternatives; never auto-removes.

conflicts.description: Pack ids this pack conflicts with. Default policy is still 'install but do not touch the existing pack'; the list only drives a warning.

dec_mem.description: Declared decode working set in bytes; 0 = engine ABI default.

generation.description: Pack generation; bumped when codec behaviour changes so the sweep re-admits previously declined files.

offset.description: Byte offset per magic rule (parallel to sniff.magic).

enumerate.description: Container pack: enumerate members argv template.

extract.description: Container pack: extract one member argv template.

strip.description: Container pack: build the recipe argv template.

rebuild.description: Container pack: rebuild the container argv template.

map.description: Container pack: emit the FS-owned member map (makes the pack seekable).

depends.description: External tools required at runtime. invfs-pack checks these and prints the distro install command; it never installs them.

recommends.description: External tools that improve coverage but are not required.

requires.description: Legacy v1 engine alias for the comma-joined depends list; retained so the current engine still probes tools.

payload.version.description: WP619: upstream tool version pinned by this fat pack (e.g. "5.8.1"). Exact pin; no ranges.

payload.url.description: WP619: provenance URL of the vendored payload tarball (may differ from where the bits were fetched when the upstream host is unreachable; the sha256 decides).

payload.sha256.description: WP619: sha256 of the vendored payload/<file>; verified fail-closed by tools/build-payloads.sh before any build.

payload.bin.description: WP619: comma-separated tool names this payload installs into <pack>/bin/ (resolved before PATH by the engine, so bundled-first with externals as fallback).

blob_ext.description: WP619: staged-filename suffix for the codec blob side (decode input in<blob_ext>, encode output out<blob_ext>). For extension-sniffing tools (mac wants in.ape, wavpack forces out.wv). Absent = bare in/out.

raw_ext.description: WP619: staged-filename suffix for the raw side (encode input in<raw_ext>, decode output out<raw_ext>; e.g. wavpack wants in.wav and wvunpack writes out.wav for a bare -o out). Absent = bare in/out.
